entries.ea961b33c2f8fe68: It is advancing its 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2024,' which covers the five years from the fiscal year ended March 2025 to the fiscal year ended March 2029. In the Autobacs Business, it aims to become the number-one store in its area, building on its hospitality and customer service capabilities and the technical skills of its pit services, and plans a 20-store structure through opening five stores by the fiscal year ended March 2029. In the Food and Beverage Business, it plans to launch the business in earnest through the opening of the Italian restaurant 'PISOLA' and build it into a pillar of management alongside the Autobacs Business.
